experiments.label: Original Lex30 - written v1
experiments.notes: Baseline written Lex30 using the original 30 cue words.

experiments.label: Updated Lex30 - written pilot v0.1
experiments.notes: Draft candidate set generated from bundled NJ8, BNC/COCA, NGSL, and AntBNC resources; requires researcher review before validation use.

experiments.label: Updated Lex30 - listening pilot v0.1
experiments.notes: Audio-presentation draft using the same candidate cues as the written pilot; audio files must be generated before administration.

experiments.label: Updated Lex30 - written easy-cue pilot v0.2
experiments.notes: Draft with all stimulus cues restricted to NJ8 K1 rank <= 1000.

experiments.label: Updated Lex30 - listening easy-cue pilot v0.2
experiments.notes: Listening draft with all stimulus cues restricted to NJ8 K1 rank <= 1000; audio files must be generated before administration.

experiments.label: Updated Lex30 - written easy-cue POS-balanced pilot v0.3
experiments.notes: Draft with all stimulus cues restricted to NJ8 K1 rank <= 1000 and WordNet primary-POS counts matched to the original Lex30 baseline.

experiments.label: Updated Lex30 - listening easy-cue POS-balanced pilot v0.3
experiments.notes: Frozen listening pilot with easy NJ8 K1 cues, original-like WordNet primary-POS counts, and approved Matilda American English audio. Validation data still need to be collected before final-test claims.

experiments.label: Updated Lex30 - listening follow-up pilot v0.4
experiments.notes: Lex30-compatible listening association task plus post-task cue recognition, Japanese meaning, and receptive semantic-depth probes for all 30 cues. Uses the frozen v0.3 cue/audio set.
